sec10-EFFECTIVE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at A/A.01 | No effective date is established by the revision label; retain the accepted effective-date disposition.
sec10-BANK | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at A/A.01 | No total knowledge-test question-bank size has been verified.
sec10-HIGH-BEAM-SCOPE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page90 L49-50 recommends high beams whenever there is no opposing traffic and says twice the low-beam range; page91 L5-12 requires low beams when following, in heavy traffic, fog, snow or heavy rain. Do not teach the page90 statement as unconditional or the range ratio as a guarantee.
sec10-FLOOD-DEPTH-ASSUMPTIONS | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page91 L30-34 says six inches reaches the bottom of most passenger cars with loss-of-control/stall risk and two feet of rushing water can carry most vehicles. Vehicle, current and road assumptions are not specified; retain both figures as source debt and do not infer a safe crossing depth.
sec10-WORK-ZONE-INJURY-COUNT | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page91 L43-46 gives approximately40000 annual work-zone crash injuries without a study date or data source. Do not present it as a current annual count.
sec10-WORK-ZONE-ALL-SIGNS | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page91 L48-53 says all temporary work-zone signs have orange backgrounds and black symbols. This blanket statement does not establish every regulatory sign's appearance; use text-supported orange work-zone cues without an all-sign guarantee.
sec10-ANIMAL-LIGHT-ADVICE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page92 L36 recommends flashers or a headlight signal to warn other drivers, while L38-40 warns that flashing headlights may freeze a deer in the road. The target and use of the headlight signal require clarification; hazard-flasher warning remains supported.
sec10-DOG-ACCELERATION | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page93 L6-8 directs slowing for a chasing dog and accelerating as it nears. Speed, clearance and surrounding-traffic conditions are absent; withhold a universal acceleration maneuver pending clarification.
sec-SPECIAL-MARKET | source_missing | owner SMEResearchAgent | tier reputable | at E/E.01 | Demand, seasonality, prices, pass rates, buyer profiles, voice of customer and ad hooks for Kansas Special driving situations have not been researched.
sec-SPECIAL-TEARDOWN | source_missing | owner SMEResearchAgent | tier reputable | at E2/E2.01 | Kansas competitor evidence for Special driving situations has not been gathered.
Dynamic facts: Temporary controls change with roadwork, and weather changes traction and visibility. Edition-bound distances, statistics and unresolved maneuvers require issuer refresh or explicit debt resolution.
Official exam metadata comes only from the bound source scope; pedagogic emphasis is not an official domain weighting. Independent factual QA remains pending.

corpus_stability.reason: The bound Kansas handbook has one February 2022 revision label; the selected source contains no evidence of multiple annual corpus rewrites. Later legal or administrative changes require issuer rechecking.
